title: Watch the teaser trailer for ‘Bloodaxe,’ the epic Viking drama coming to Prime Video January 20, 2027
summary: The highly anticipated new series, which has been renewed for Season 2, is helmed by Michael Hirst (creator of ‘Vikings’) and Horatio Hirst.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- All episodes of


Bloodaxe


arrive on Prime Video on January 20, 2027. Watch the teaser trailer above.


- From showrunners Michael Hirst (creator of


Vikings


) and Horatio Hirst, the show chronicles the rise of historical Norse raider, Erik Bloodaxe.


- Xavier Molyneux and Jessica Madsen lead the cast of the show, which has been renewed for Season 2.


---


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) has revealed the first teaser trailer and release date for


Bloodaxe,


the highly anticipated new series from the creator of hit show


Vikings


.


The epic historical drama tells the true story of one of history’s most famous Viking warlords and has already been renewed for a second season.


[Top 10 Original films and series on Prime Video: See the weekly rankings](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-top-10-movies-shows)


From action-packed films to buzzy series, here are the Original titles Prime Video members watched most from October 26–November 1.


The teaser trailer and premiere date were revealed at New York Comic Con (NYCC) on October 9, where fans were immersed in the world of 10th-century Norway during a


Bloodaxe


panel which showcased the action-packed series.


Here’s everything you need to know about


Bloodaxe


, which arrives on Prime Video on January 20, 2027.


## What is ‘Bloodaxe’ about?


Season 1 of


Bloodaxe


chronicles the rise of one of history’s most famous Norse raiders, Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife Gunnhild. As they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals.


With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom—drawing in the ruthless kings of other Scandinavian countries and even a powerful English ruler—the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling, and utterly magical new Norse saga.


## How to watch ‘Bloodaxe’ on Prime Video


All eight episodes of Season 1 will premiere exclusively on Prime Video on January 20, 2027, in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.


Prime Video is included with an


[Amazon Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) , which costs $14.99 monthly or $139 annually in the U.S. Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and


[qualifying government assistance recipients](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) at 50% off.


Check your local Amazon website for information on Prime membership pricing in your region.


Not a member yet? Start a


[30-day free trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) today.


## Who is in the ‘Bloodaxe’ Season 1 cast?


The first season of


Bloodaxe


stars:


- Xavier Molyneux (


Neighbours


) as Erik Bloodaxe


- Jessica Madsen (


Bridgerton


) as Gunnhild, Mother of Kings


- Karlis Arnolds Avots (


January


) as Egil Skallagrimsson


- Levi Miller (


[Pan](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B016D5RL02?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr01eeb7_pvsemanticsearchtitle_1_1) ) as Haakon the Good


- Rod Hallett (


[Outlander](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0HGQDVWHV?pageTypeId=B0HGQDY6DF&qid=1791553855688&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_3_1_2&sr=1-2) ) as King Athelstan


- Alina Tomnikov (


Donna


) as the dual roles of Greta and The Seer


- Sisse Marie (


Rebel Moon


) as Queen Thyra


- Rune Temte (


[Eddie the Eagle](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B01BXIIJ8C?pageTypeId=B01BXL0HY8&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr62ef6f_1_1_1&qid=1791553908746&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&sr=1-1) ) as King Gorm


- Jesper Christensen (


[Spectre](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0CJ5S4JJJ?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr62ef6f_1_1_1&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&pageTypeId=B017HYSNWI&qid=1791553986702&sr=1-1) ) as King Harald Fairhair


## Who is the team behind ‘Bloodaxe’?


Bloodaxe


is executive produced by Michael Hirst (


[Vikings](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B00BXOC74E?qid=1791554596727&pageTypeId=B00BLCHMPM&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_1_1_1&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&sr=1-1) ) and his son Horatio Hirst. The duo are also the showrunners and writers.


[Amazon CEO Andy Jassy on Prime Video: ‘That business is growing, it’s profitable, and it’s still early’](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/amazon-ceo-andy-jassy-on-prime-video-growth)


Jassy discussed Prime Video's momentum during a recent Q&A with shareholders, pointing to original films, live sports, and streaming partnerships.


Additional executive producers include Morgan O’Sullivan under his O’Sullivan Productions label, Steve Stark under his Toluca Pictures label, Arturo Interian, John Weber, Sheila Hockin, and Fred Toye. Bloodaxe is produced by MGM Television, a division of Amazon MGM Studios.


## Will there be a ‘Bloodaxe’ Season 2?


Ahead of Season 1’s premiere,


Bloodaxe


has been picked up for a second season, which is currently in production in Ireland.


New cast members joining the show for Season 2 are:


- Gard Løkke (


Home for Christmas


)


- Melina Åkerman (


Granite Harbour


)


- Kieran Bew (


[House of the Dragon](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0HB7RN26T?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_2_1_2&qid=1791554675403&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&pageTypeId=B0HB7JRZ1J&sr=1-2) )


- Sebastian Bull (


2 Days


)


- George Burgess (


[Beast](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0GVBP2JVF?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr62ef6f_2_1_2&qid=1791554790562&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&pageTypeId=B0GVBKDSRV&sr=1-2) )


- Maddy Ambus (


The Return of Stanley Atwell


)


- Steven Brand (


[Saw X](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0FM229B1H?pageTypeId=B0CH9FK27R&qid=1791554862624&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr62ef6f_2_1_1&sr=1-1) )


- Lasse Steen (


[The Promised Land](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0CV4NQS7Q?pageTypeId=B0CV4PNJ1V&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&qid=1791554913859&sr=1-1&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr9f90f0_1_1_1) )


The recurring character played by Steen will be first introduced during Season 1.


## What else is on Prime Video?


There are plenty of other action-packed series available to watch on Prime Video including


[Jack Ryan](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/watch-jack-ryan-prime-video) ,


[Neagley](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/watch-neagley-reacher-prime-video) , and


[Fallout](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fallout-season-2-season-3-prime-video) .


Prime Video is a


[first-stop entertainment destination](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/entertainment) offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite


[movies](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-original-films) ,


[series](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-original-series) , documentaries, and


[live sports](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/live-sports-streaming-prime-video) .


['Reacher' renewed for Season 6 after record-breaking Season 4](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-reacher-how-to-watch)


The global hit action series will get a sixth season as Season 4 reached 66 million viewers in its first 28 days and 200 million viewers worldwide.


These include


[Amazon MGM Studios](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/mgm) –produced series and movies, licensed fan favorites, and


[programming through subscriptions](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-are-prime-video-channels) on Prime Video such as Paramount+,


[MGM+](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-you-need-to-know-about-mgm-plus) ,


[Apple TV](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/apple-tv-shows-amazon-prime-video-subscription) ,


[HBO Max](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/hbo-max-on-prime-video-channels) ,


[Peacock](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/peacock-shows-movies-prime-video-subscription) ,


[FOX One](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fox-one-news-sports-entertainment-prime-video-subscription) ,


[DAZN](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-dazn-sports-subscription) , and


[Crunchyroll](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/crunchyroll-anime-subscription-amazon-prime-video) , as well as more than 900 free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels in the U.S.


All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

[Vought Rising](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/the-boys-vought-rising-prime-video) ,


the prequel series to


[The Boys](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/the-boys-eric-kripke-season-5-prime-video) that will premiere exclusively on Prime Video in 2027.
